title.zh: 刑事诉讼（保留与过渡规定——披露）条例 2025
title.en: Criminal Procedure (Saving and Transitional Provisions — Disclosure) Regulations 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Criminal Procedure (Saving and Transitional Provisions — Disclosure) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 14 February 2025.

3.—(1) Despite sections 14, 15, 18, 19 and 20 of the Act and subject to regulations 5 and 6, sections 159, 163, 214, 215 and 216 of the Code as in force immediately before 14 February 2025 continue to apply to an accused in relation to an offence to be tried, if the accused was charged with the offence before that date.
(2) Subject to regulations 5 and 6, section 221B(3)(b) and (c) and (4)(b) of the Code (as inserted by section 23 of the Act) does not apply to an accused in relation to an offence to be tried, if the accused was charged with the offence before 14 February 2025.

heading.en: Consequences of non‑compliance with disclosure procedures

text.en:
4.—(1) Despite section 17 of the Act and subject to regulations 5 and 6, section 169(1) and (2) of the Code as in force immediately before 14 February 2025 continues to apply to an accused in relation to an offence to be tried, if the accused was charged with the offence before that date.
(2) Subject to regulations 5 and 6, section 221(1)(a) and (b) and (2) of the Code (as inserted by section 22 of the Act) does not apply to an accused in relation to an offence to be tried, if the accused was charged with the offence before 14 February 2025.

heading.en: Further proceedings where additional charges preferred
